name: Frozen-V3 exhaustive historical critical-rescue discovery scan
purpose: Determine whether real historical Headroom regressions exist in which baseline relevance drops already-retrieved historical-fix-critical production evidence and frozen V3 trajectory relevance retains it.

candidate_universe.history: all non-merge commits before the V3 algorithm freeze
candidate_universe.subject: fix-like commits
requires: at least one Python production file under headroom/
at least one Python test file under tests/
does not touch V3 treatment files
historical production patch reverses cleanly on V3 freeze
changed tests pass on pristine V3 freeze
reversed production patch yields pytest rc=1
exactly one or two failing tests
at least one failing test-name bridge absent from the user prompt

prompt: same deterministic test-file-only challenge prompt family used by the locked bridge-hard benchmark

target_construction.critical_records: non-empty buggy production lines within +/-5 lines of historical production diff hunks
target_construction.bridge_anchors: real changed-test-file lines containing failing test-name bridges

outcomes.opportunity_task: baseline drops at least one critical record
outcomes.rescue_task: at least one critical record changes baseline DROP to V3 KEEP
outcomes.regression_task: at least one critical record changes baseline KEEP to V3 DROP

stopping_rule: scan the entire eligible candidate universe; do not stop after finding a positive result
constraints: no alternative distractor seed after results
report denominator and all evaluable tasks
report both DROP-to-KEEP and KEEP-to-DROP outcomes
previously evaluated commits are flagged rather than silently removed
